definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is true to a greater degree than usual.

definitions.gloss: ironically, as luck would have it
definitions.explanation: Introduces an ironic or unexpected situation (often as 〜なことに).

examples.japanese: ⟦{皮肉|ひにく}→皮肉：00103_hiniku⟧なことに、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
ことに{冬|ふゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寒|さむ}い。
{残念|ざんねん}なことに、{雨|あめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
{幸|さいわ}いなことに、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
ことに has two distinct uses as an adverb.

USE 1: ESPECIALLY
- Emphasizes degree
- Similar to {特|とく}に, {殊|こと}に
- ことに〜だ/ことに〜が〜

USE 2: 〜なことに (IRONICALLY/FORTUNATELY)
- Introduces situation with emotional evaluation
- Always follows na-adjective or の

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {皮肉|ひにく}なことに (ironically)
- {残念|ざんねん}なことに (unfortunately)
- {幸|さいわ}いなことに (fortunately)
- {驚|おどろ}いたことに (surprisingly)
- {困|こま}ったことに (unfortunately, problematically)

NOTE: When written as {殊|こと}に, it typically means "especially" (sense 1).
